value_stream.name: Operational Excellence, Process Mining & Continuous Improvement Program

fields.Participants: Finance (links to VS-17.4), process owners, sponsors, Audit (links to VS-21)
fields.Volume: Enterprise benefit portfolio (margin, cost, working-capital, NPS)

workflows.name: Benefit Case Modeling, Tracking & Realization Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - Benefit auto-reconciliation to GL; run-rate vs one-time classification
Controls: - CTL-631: benefit case approved by Finance (segregation from OpEx sponsor); realized benefit reconciled to P&L
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-33 (performance), VS-21 (audit), VS-135 (TBM value realization)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overstate risk**: Soft benefits never realized; mitigated by Finance sign-off and P&L reconciliation
- **Attribution risk**: Benefit claimed that would have happened anyway; mitigated by baseline discipline and counter-factual reasoning
System Touchpoints: - Benefit-tracking tool; GL/FP&A (links to VS-17.4); corporate performance (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: OpEx/Finance build the benefit case at charter (hard/soft, P&L vs balance-sheet, baseline, annualization, confidence), with Finance sign-off on the model
OpEx/Finance track realization monthly/quarterly against the case, distinguish run-rate vs one-time, and reconcile to the P&L (links to VS-17.4)
OpEx report realized benefit to the executive/Board (links to VS-33/VS-36), and flag shortfalls for action

fields.Owner: OpEx Data Lead / BI (links to VS-28)
fields.Volume: Enterprise process performance (~5,427 workflows across 188 value streams)

workflows.name: Process Performance Monitoring & Control Tower Dashboard

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time exception detection; automated root-cause hypothesis on alert; action auto-routing
Controls: - CTL-631: KPI definitions governed (W4054); alert changes approved
Pain Points / Risks: - **Alert-fatigue risk**: Too many low-value alerts; mitigated by threshold tuning and severity tiers
- **Metric-gaming risk**: Behavior distorted by narrow KPIs; mitigated by balanced KPI set and cross-process view
System Touchpoints: - BI platform (links to VS-28); process mining (W4058); KPI library (W4054); ERP event streams (links to VS-08/VS-15)

steps.activity: OpEx/BI build the process-performance control tower: KPIs (W4054), process-mining health (W4058), exception/alerts, and trend vs target, by process and site
OpEx/Ops leadership review exceptions weekly, trigger improvement actions or investigations, and route to the pipeline (W4052)
OpEx tune alert thresholds, reduce false positives, and evolve the dashboard with the capability

fields.Participants: HR/Workforce Planning (links to VS-103.3/VS-19.3), store/DC leadership, Finance (VS-17.4)
fields.Trigger: Annual productivity target; labor-cost pressure; capacity need
fields.Volume: ~6,762 employees + contingent (links to VS-98); revenue/employee target ~PHP 9.21M

Automation Opportunity: - Labor-standard modeling from event data; capacity-demand matching
Controls: - CTL-631 (ensure controlled execution — Productivity, Benefit Realization & OpEx Analytics (PA-133.3).)
- CTL-631: productivity changes validated against service-level and DOLE compliance
Cross-references: - links to VS-19.3 (WFM), VS-103.3 (workforce planning), VS-84 (labor), VS-98 (contingent)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Burnout risk**: Productivity push overloads staff; mitigated by DOLE compliance and capacity-redployment
- **Service-risk**: Cutting labor harms customer experience; mitigated by balanced productivity+service KPIs
System Touchpoints: - WFM/scheduling (links to VS-19.3); process mining (W4058); HR/people analytics (links to VS-103.3)

steps.activity: OpEx/HR establish productivity baselines and targets (sales/labor-hour, units/labor-hour, cost-per-transaction) by function/site, aligned to staffing model (links to VS-19.3)
OpEx lead productivity improvement: standard work, scheduling optimization, cross-training (links to VS-19/HR-022), automation (W4062), layout/tools
OpEx/HR monitor productivity uplift, redeploy freed capacity to growth (not just cut), and ensure DOLE-compliant staffing (links to VS-84)

fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), Procurement (VS-15/VS-34), Supply Chain (VS-02/VS-06), IT (VS-135), sponsors
fields.Trigger: Margin-pressure; annual cost-out target; strategic initiative
fields.Volume: Enterprise cost-out portfolio (supply chain, opex, technology, procurement)

Automation Opportunity: - Cost-out portfolio analytics; auto-reconciliation to P&L; guardrail-KPI alerting
Controls: - CTL-631 (ensure controlled execution — Productivity, Benefit Realization & OpEx Analytics (PA-133.3).)
- CTL-631: cost-out reconciled by Finance; guardrail KPIs (quality/service/safety) monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-105 (SCF), VS-110 (freight), VS-135 (TBM), VS-34 (expense), VS-17.4 (FP&A)
Pain Points / Risks: - **False-savings risk**: Cost cut that increases total cost or harms revenue; mitigated by total-cost-of-ownership lens and guardrail KPIs
- **One-time-vs-run-rate risk**: Counting one-time savings as recurring; mitigated by Finance classification
System Touchpoints: - Benefit tracking (W4065); FP&A (VS-17.4); procurement (VS-15/VS-34); freight (VS-110); TBM (VS-135)

steps.activity: OpEx/Finance establish the cost-out target and portfolio across levers (procurement/sourcing, logistics/freight, energy, technology, opex, working capital), with owners and benefit cases (W4065)
OpEx coordinate execution across functions (links to VS-105 SCF, VS-110 freight, VS-135 TBM, VS-34 expense), manage dependencies, and track realization
OpEx/Finance ensure cost-out does not harm customer/quality/safety/service (guardrail KPIs), reconcile to the P&L, and report to the Board

fields.Participants: Process owners, Supply Chain (VS-02/VS-06/VS-04), Finance (VS-15/VS-16), ecommerce (VS-10)
fields.Volume: Key end-to-end flows: order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, DC-to-store replenishment, ecommerce fulfillment, store receiving

Automation Opportunity: - Cycle-time auto-measurement from event timestamps; bottleneck auto-detection
Controls: - CTL-631 (ensure controlled execution — Productivity, Benefit Realization & OpEx Analytics (PA-133.3).)
- CTL-631: cycle-time KPI paired with quality/service KPI
Cross-references: - links to VS-02 (supply), VS-04 (DC), VS-06 (logistics), VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-15/VS-16 (P2P/O2C)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Local-optimum risk**: Speeding one step creates a bottleneck downstream; mitigated by end-to-end value-stream view
- **Quality-vs-speed risk**: Faster but buggier; mitigated by paired quality KPIs (W4070)
System Touchpoints: - Process mining (W4058); ERP/WMS/ecommerce timestamps; control tower (W4066)

steps.activity: OpEx baseline cycle-time/throughput/lead-time for key flows (order-to-delivery, PO-to-receipt, DC-to-store, ecommerce pick-to-ship) using process mining (W4058) and ERP data
OpEx lead cycle-time reduction (eliminate wait, parallelize, automate, reduce variability) and validate improvement vs target
OpEx monitor sustained cycle-time KPIs on the control tower (W4066) and re-engage on regression

fields.Owner: OpEx Process Lead / Quality (links to VS-31)
fields.Participants: Quality (VS-31), process owners, CX (links to VS-13), Audit (VS-21)
fields.Volume: Defects across receiving, picking, fulfillment, fabrication (VS-09), data quality, invoice matching

Automation Opportunity: - Defect auto-detection from event/log data; error-proofing via system validation
Controls: - CTL-631 (ensure controlled execution — Productivity, Benefit Realization & OpEx Analytics (PA-133.3).)
- CTL-631: defect KPIs tracked; quality holds (links to VS-31)
Cross-references: - links to VS-31 (quality), VS-13 (CX/complaints), VS-05 (inventory accuracy)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-defect risk**: Defects not captured; mitigated by mining and exception capture
- **Whack-a-mole risk**: Fixing one defect type creates another; mitigated by systemic RCA (W4059)
System Touchpoints: - Quality system (links to VS-31); process mining (W4058); CX/VOC (links to VS-13); benefit tracking (W4065)

steps.activity: OpEx/Quality baseline defect/rework rates and costs (picking errors, receiving discrepancies, returns, invoice exceptions, data-quality defects) from mining (W4058) and quality data (VS-31)
OpEx lead defect-reduction (poka-yoke/error-proofing, system validation, training, automation) and validate improvement
OpEx monitor sustained defect rates, tie to CX/complaints (VS-13) and cost (W4065), and report

fields.Participants: OpEx CoE, PMO (VS-112), sponsors, process owners, Finance (VS-17.4)

workflows.name: Improvement Project Portfolio Review & Lessons Learned

Automation Opportunity: - Portfolio health analytics; lessons-learned tagging and search
Controls: - CTL-631 (ensure controlled execution — Productivity, Benefit Realization & OpEx Analytics (PA-133.3).)
- CTL-631: stage-gate and kill-criteria documented; lessons captured at close
Pain Points / Risks: - **No-learning risk**: Mistakes repeated across projects; mitigated by lessons capture and reuse
- **Zombie-project risk**: Projects kept alive past their value; mitigated by monthly portfolio review and kill-criteria
System Touchpoints: - Project/CI tool (links to VS-112); knowledge/SOP library (links to VS-30.3); benefit tracking (W4065)

steps.activity: OpEx/PMO review the portfolio monthly: active projects, stage-gate health, benefit trajectory, capacity, and at-risk items
OpEx capture lessons learned at each project close (what worked, what didn't, reusable assets) and feed back into methodology (W4051) and the suggestion system (W4056)
OpEx publish reusable assets (templates, standard work, playbooks) and retire/cancel projects that no longer justify investment

workflows.name: OpEx Maturity Assessment & Annual Program Review

Controls: - CTL-631 (ensure controlled execution — Productivity, Benefit Realization & OpEx Analytics (PA-133.3).)
- CTL-631: annual review with Board oversight; independent assurance option via Audit (VS-21)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stagnation risk**: Program plateaus; mitigated by maturity assessment and external benchmarking
- **Relevance risk**: OpEx detached from strategy; mitigated by annual strategic alignment
System Touchpoints: - Performance (links to VS-33); governance (links to VS-36); benefit tracking (W4065); maturity model

steps.activity: OpEx assess OpEx maturity across dimensions (strategy, governance, methodology, process architecture, mining/analytics, culture, benefit realization) against a maturity model, and benchmark externally
OpEx review the annual program: realized benefit vs target (W4065), portfolio outcomes (W4071), maturity gaps, and the forward plan
OpEx present to the Board (links to VS-36), set next-year targets, and adjust the operating model/methodology
